peer_identity.arc_label: The Empress who bore Janus-Jana and dispatched Honorata to Othon
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Acts jointly with the Emperor in public appeals and court governance. Commands galactic-scale resources. Politically active in arranging rewards for exceptional service. Not directly quoted at length in surviving pages.
peer_identity.rationale: Split from the later reigning Empress records. This Empress is specifically Janus-Jana's biological mother; her ovum was fertilized after 30 years on a hospital-planet. She also arranged Honorata as a reward-gift for Othon. Distinct role and era from the vol11–17 Empress who appeals to Steelhead and is protected by Aghora.
